title: web-app-serve provenance annotations (schema-version 1)
description: JSON Schema for the provenance annotations written by web-app-serve-action into the wrapper chart's `.app.ingress.annotations`. Every key is prefixed with the domain `web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/`; the property names below include that full prefix because that is what appears on a live Ingress object. `schema-version` is the literal that pins this document; bumping it means editing action.yml keys, bumping the literal, and adding a new annotations-v<n>.json (keep the old files).

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/schema-vers.description: Annotation schema version. Literal set by the action; identifies which annotations-v<n>.json describes this object.

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/ref.description: Git ref name that triggered the build (github.ref_name), e.g. a branch or tag name.

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/commit-mess.description: Subject line of the built commit (git log -1 --pretty=%s).

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/actor.description: GitHub actor who triggered the run (github.actor).

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/actor-image.description: Avatar URL of the actor: https://github.com/<actor>.png.

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/repo-owner-.description: Avatar URL of the repository owner: https://github.com/<owner>.png.

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/pr-number.description: Optional. Associated pull request number, resolved from the commit via `gh api`. Omitted when the commit has no PR.

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/pr-author.description: Optional. Login of the pull request author. Omitted when the commit has no PR.

web-app-serve.togglecorp.com/pr-author-i.description: Optional. Avatar URL of the PR author: https://github.com/<pr-author>.png. Omitted when the commit has no PR.
